First Steps¶

Tutorials will give a broad overview and working knowledge of NeoDBS. Tutorials do not cover every detail so refer to the documentation on each topic to learn more.

Installing¶

Python 3.6 (64 bit) or above is required. Other requirements will be automatically installed, with requirements.txt.

pip install neodbs
